h: Nobody tells you the real cost of learning FPV.
t: It is not the drone. It is the parts after the crashes.

h: You just pulled a card and you want a price.
t: Do not look at what people are ASKING for it. Look at what it actually SOLD for, recently, in your condition.

h: Here is my grading take, and it has not changed:
t: I have only ever BOUGHT graded cards. I have never submitted one myself.

h: Somebody always asks why my cheapest cards stop at two bucks and ninety-six cents.
t: It is not a random number. Below that, the mail, the sleeve, the top loader, the team bag, and the fees eat the whole sale — and then some.

h: Five thousand seven hundred cards walked in from one trade, and they do not get sorted in…
t: They get sorted in passes. Pass one: pull the dupes and anything twenty bucks and up — those go to eBay.

h: Tuesday night question, and I want the origin story:
t: What card got you into collecting in the first place? Not your most valuable.
